author: XBOX
description:
Jan Scientist's mission continues. 

A roughly 20-hour expansion to the award-winning personal survival game The Alters - available now.

The Oasis - a lush paradise emerging from desolation - becomes Jan's obsession. One he cannot grasp alone. Assemble a crew of specialist alters: Geologist, Biologist, Chemist, Physicist. Together, you'll terraform a hostile planet, build an underground research base, and uncover mysteries that may reshape everything. But can we really understand everything?

The Alters: Last Variable is out now.

description:
Ascend to ZERO is available NOW on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC with XBOX Game Pass!

In this hack-n-slash roguelike set in the year 2225, you are the last survivor of humanity — traveling back in time where every run makes you stronger. Starting with just 30 seconds, use your time-bending ability to steal time from your enemies, wield powerful weapons and items, and experience breakneck progression as your build evolves! 

PC footage shown. Final performance and graphics may vary on XBOX consoles.

Ascend to ZERO is available now on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title.
